prs.title: fix: add scrollbar gutter to style macro
prs.author: yihuiliao
prs.body:
kept getting a maximum depth exceeded error after i merged main into this https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/pull/10600 for one specific story (which is stashed so it's not actually on the PR). this is bc the scrollbar kept appearing and disappearing, affecting the layout.

turns out in https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/pull/10577/changes i had moved `scrollbarGutter` which was previously inline to the style macro but it's not supported there so it was silently failing. this PR adds `scrollbarGutter` to the style macro theme. if we do not want to support this, we can just add it back to GridList's inline styles.

prs.author: minwookshin

Keep the page in place when Enter creates a token or Backspace removes the text after one. Measure root-level carets using the adjacent zero-width text node, and keep the empty-line fallback inside the input. The actual selection stays outside token wrappers for composition.

prs.title: feat: add turbopack support to optimize-locales
prs.author: stefanprobst
prs.body:
currently the `@react-aria/optimize-locales-plugin` does not support `turbopack`, because `turbopack` has no full plugin api and no `unplugin` integration. but `turbopack` does support [loaders](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/turbopack#configuring-webpack-loaders), so this pull request adds basically a null-loader for unused locales/messages.

see https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/discussions/8897
